journey.name: spark transfer to spending
journey.description:
Verifies the transfer to spending flow on Spark. With Spark ready, Funding leads with "Transfer From Savings" (testTag "FundTransfer") and "Use Other Wallet" (testTag "FundReceive") above "Manual Setup" (testTag "FundManual") and an enabled "Transfer from HW wallet" (testTag "FundHardware"), which opens a paired hardware wallet's transfer to spending, a funded one first, or the connect sheet when none is paired; and the Savings and Spending transfer buttons open the spending intro, then the amount screen (testTag "SpendingAmount"), instead of the Transfer Unavailable sheet. The confirm screen shows the network fee, the spending fee, what reaches spending and the total, and a choice between Instant and Later. What happens after the swipe depends on the deposit Spark sees and the provider's quote; the setting-up states are covered by the previews and unit tests, so this journey stops before the swipe.
Precondition: a build whose Spark reads Bitkit's chain (mainnet with a Breez key, or a regtest build launched with SPARK_CHAIN_SERVICE_URL set to the regtest's Esplora URL; Spark's default regtest is its own chain, so without it the Savings transfer shows the Transfer Unavailable sheet), a freshly onboarded wallet with a positive on-chain Savings balance and no channels. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap the Savings balance card (testTag "ActivitySavings"), tap "Transfer To Spending" (testTag "TransferToSpending") and verify the spending intro (testTag "SpendingIntro") opens, not the Transfer Unavailable sheet
Tap "Get Started" (testTag "SpendingIntro-button") and verify the amount screen (testTag "SpendingAmount") opens with the available amount
Tap "25%" (testTag "SpendingAmountQuarter") and verify the amount is about a quarter of the Savings balance; tap "Max" (testTag "SpendingAmountMax") and verify the amount equals the available amount

Tap "Continue" (testTag "SpendingAmountContinue") and verify the confirm screen shows "Network fees", "Spending fee", "To spending" and "Total", with "Instant" (testTag "SpendingConfirmInstant") selected and "Later" (testTag "SpendingConfirmLater") below it
Verify "Spending fee" reads "±" an amount equal to the Instant row's fee, and "To spending" equals the amount less that fee
Tap "Later" and verify "Spending fee" shows "±" the Later row's fee and "To spending" grows by the difference, while "Network fees" and "Total" stay the same
Tap "Learn More" (testTag "SpendingConfirmMore"), verify the screen explains Instant and Later and shows a spending-only balance bar, then tap "Understood" (testTag "LiquidityContinue")

Go back to the wallet home, tap the Spending balance card (testTag "ActivitySpending"), tap "Transfer From Savings" (testTag "TransferFromSavings") and verify the amount screen opens without the intro
Go back to the wallet home, open Settings › Advanced › Lightning Connections and tap add connection (testTag "add_connection_button")

Verify "Transfer From Savings" (testTag "FundTransfer") and "Use Other Wallet" (testTag "FundReceive") are enabled above "Manual Setup" (testTag "FundManual"), and "Transfer from HW wallet" (testTag "FundHardware") is enabled below it
With no hardware wallet paired, tap "Transfer from HW wallet" and verify the connect hardware wallet sheet opens; close it
Tap "Transfer From Savings" and verify the amount screen (testTag "SpendingAmount") opens
